t: At auction, can we force sellers to sell? Buyers to buy? | Mike Brandly, Auctioneer Blog
s: March 15, 2021 - Our subject today involves when there is a breach of contract (as an auctioneer has announced, “Sold!” — for instance) and then the seller refuses to sell or the buyer refuses to buy. What happens next? Can the seller pursue the buyer for civil or criminal damages? Can the buyer pursue the seller for civil or criminal damages? Assuming that no money has been paid and no property has changed hands … yet, basically a good rule to remember is “A buyer can force a seller to sell, but a seller can’t force a buyer to buy.”
